name: Digital Garden
description: A Knowledge Collection site with a persistent directory explorer and linked note reader.

navigation.identity: stable item id; labels and paths may be edited
navigation.path_policy: one leading slash; no external/protocol-relative URL, query, fragment, backslash, or dot segment

media.validated_format: Image and PDF fixture assets are supported by the Knowledge Collection POC; additional resource behavior remains under development.

content_types.identity: stable note ID supplied by the Knowledge Collection input
content_types.public_path: template-generated from the collection mount path and note identity
content_types.frontmatter_policy: Frontmatter is optional and extensible; templates use recognized values and ignore other properties.
